info.name: WorldCat Entity Data Bibliographic Resources Member Enabled Providers API
Find member enabled providers in the WorldCat Knowledge base

params.name: alt
params.description: Format to return results in. application/xml or application/json

params.name: provider_uid
params.description: Identifier of the provider associated with the collection

params.name: startIndex
params.description: start position of the results to return (1 based), default 1

params.name: itemsPerPage
params.description: maximum number of records to return, maximum 50, default 10

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Criteria for sorting the results. possible sorting criteria are title, relevancy, holdings, preference, issn, isbn, oclcnum
